frequency_question: How often does institutional/structural friction prevent a proposed macroprudential buffer from being finalized above zero within the given window?
membership_rule: Includes all Board of Governors rulemakings on CCyB, stress capital buffers, or Basel III endgame capital adjustments from 2010 to 2024. Excludes routine microprudential technical corrections.

cases.name: CCyB Rate Set at 0% (Multiple periodic reviews)

coverage_note: 5 major macroprudential capital rule events identified; captures the primary friction-laden attempts in the post-Dodd-Frank era.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments to sectoral countercyclical buffers if any were contemplated internally without public notice.
skeleton: Regulatory capital enhancement proposals since post-crisis framework establishment (2010-2024)
multiplier: 3 successful major capital requirement adjustments or framework establishments out of 5 distinct significant macroprudential policy pushes
validity_reason: The structural apparatus of the Federal Reserve Board rulemaking process and inter-agency coordination (FDIC/OCC) remains stable under the Dodd-Frank architecture.
